name: ruyi-version-check
description: Deterministic version-consistency checker — verifies every version surface in a skill collection agrees with the canonical frontmatter before release

plugins.name: ruyi-version-check
plugins.description: Reads the canonical version from each skill's SKILL.md frontmatter and checks every surface — manifests, Phase 0 banner, README badges, CHANGELOG, dist platform copies, and test literals — agrees with it. Pure read-only; exits non-zero on mismatch. Run before release, on suspected drift, or in CI.
